title: Paint-Out Tomorrow
content: If you're in the New York State area tomorrow, please stop by the village of Rhinebeck in the Hudson Valley for the 7th Annual Plein-Air Paint-Out and Auction.A paint-out is an event where professional artists gather on-site in the morning to create a painting, which is framed and auctioned in the afternoon. It's the closest thing to tightrope walking or improv theater in the painting business.The autumn color is at peak and the weather promises to be sunny. Over fifty artists will be attending, includingJim Adair,Gary Fifer,Tarryl Gabel,Keith Gunderson,Betsy Jacaruso,Hae Suk Kim,Seth A. Nadel,Robert Schneider,and me.-------------For more information, and the complete list of artists,link.For a listing of other plein air events, and a great site for the on-site painting information, visitOutdoorPainting.com
